what: Plan edge cases claim a rewritten inventory row has exactly two pipe boundary characters
scenario_or_breakage: Markdown table rows need leading separator and trailing pipes (three pipe characters minimum on one line); an implementer validating against two pipes may accept a malformed row or over-trim delimiters
suggested_fix: Revise the edge-case note to require the same three-pipe single-line shape as sibling inventory rows (leading pipe, column separator, trailing pipe)
